entry.title: New: Resolution 520 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, FOR A GRANT TO THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT

Allows for the receipt of $75,000 of federally-derived funds to advance Hawai‘i County’s work on Multi-Modal Transportation Safety.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 520-24 - 05/15/24
